Only the replacement WHOLE-REPO procedure governs the continued audit; the response does not combine concurrent mode procedures
Active Work.AuditTarget is cleared when services/billing no longer represents the active audit focus
The refreshed CONTEXT.md corrects stale global claims using primary evidence and remains a coherent baseline rather than an audit diary

evals.prompt: Continue the active STANDARDS workflow as Auditor. ProjectMode is BROWNFIELD, WorkflowState is AUDITING, Active Work.Architecture points to a completed technical design that assumes the service can rely on a single-instance in-memory scheduler, and the active recovery frame is Owner=AUDITING, FailureType=PROJECT_CONTEXT, From=DEVELOPING, ResumeAt=DEVELOPING, RerunThrough=NONE. Developer routed here after discovering that deployment topology in project context might be stale. During evidence-backed audit you establish that the production service is deployed with multiple replicas and project policy requires stateless application instances. Correct the factual context, but do not edit or replace the architecture artifact yourself.
evals.expected_output: An Auditor-owned PROJECT_CONTEXT recovery that corrects CONTEXT.md, recognizes that the completed technical design must be re-established, sets the existing recovery frame's RerunThrough to ARCHITECTING, and routes to Architect without creating a nested architecture failure or redesigning the scheduler.
assertions: The response records the multi-replica deployment and stateless-instance policy in CONTEXT.md as evidence-backed current constraints
It does not rewrite the Architect artifact or choose a replacement scheduling mechanism
It identifies the completed technical design as invalidated by corrected project context
Because Auditor owns the active PROJECT_CONTEXT recovery frame, it does not push a nested ARCHITECTURE failure frame for the same invalidation
It keeps ResumeAt=DEVELOPING, sets the existing frame's RerunThrough to ARCHITECTING, and preserves the frame on the recovery stack
It transitions AUDITING -> ARCHITECTING as a recovery-directed RESUME handoff rather than taking the normal brownfield AUDITING -> SCOPING path
It provides the next-role Architect invocation after persisting the transition
